title: Peace Tower Carillon (Ottawa)

place.label: Peace Tower, Parliament Hill, Ottawa

mass_note: about 54 t for all bells; bourdon 10,090 kg (House of Commons)

tiers.everyday: The Peace Tower in Ottawa holds a carillon of 53 bells, inaugurated on 1 July 1927. The biggest bell weighs over 10 tonnes.
tiers.student: House of Commons heritage: 53 bells cast 1925–27 by Gillett & Johnston, inaugurated on 1 July 1927; bourdon 10,090 kg (E) with a 229 kg clapper, smallest bell 4.5 kg, about 54 t in all.

model.label: Not modelled: a ring, carillon or set has no single bell profile in the cited sources.
